title: Provision of Generator shed at Kannur Lighthouse
summary: E-tender for constructing a generator shed at Kannur Lighthouse, Kerala, with a corrigendum extending the bid dates.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin

scope.item: Provision of Generator shed (no BOQ in these documents)

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents by post or in person. Bid Securing Declaration listed among required documents.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%; similar works = construction of generator shed with truss work, concrete foundation and aluminium work / construction or maintenance of residential, institutional or office buildings, road, lighthouse tower or other related civil construction
PAN and GST registration; annual turnover of last three years certified by CA
Declaration that bid is unconditional; affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper of not being blacklisted
Undertaking listing relatives serving as Gazetted/Account Officers in MoPSW or DGLL
Copy of EPF/labour registration certificate; Tender Acceptance Letter; Bid Securing Declaration

corrigenda.change: Corrigendum-III: last date for bid submission extended to 11.11.2025 15:00; EMD/technical documents (original) to 10.11.2025 15:00; technical bid opening 12.11.2025 15:00

documents.file: CORRIGENDUM-III Provision of Generator Shed at Kannur Lighthouse.pdf

notes: Original NIT dates: bid download/submission 24.09.2025 10:00 to 08.10.2025 15:00; bid query 29.09.2025; EMD 07.10.2025; opening 09.10.2025 (listing matches original dates). Dates above reflect Corrigendum-III; Corrigenda I and II are not attached. No generator shed dimensions or BOQ.
